name: Call of Duty: Black Ops (Plutonium Mod)

configurationFields.label: Spielmodus
configurationFields.description: Sets the game mode. Configure the relevant config file accordingly - 'Plutonium/storage/t5/dedicated.cfg' for Multiplayer, 'Plutonium/storage/t5/dedicated_sp.cfg' for Zombies

configurationFields.label: Server Key
configurationFields.description: Sets the [server key](https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys) required to run the server. This also sets the server name. A Plutonium account must be at least one week old to create a key, and game ownership must be [verified](https://forum.plutonium.pw/topic/32250/an-update-on-game-ownership-verification)

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Map Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to enable map rotation (the Map Rotation List must then also be set) or to load a specific initial map (the Initial Game Type and Initial Map must then also be set, as applicable)

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation List
configurationFields.description: Configure the map rotation in 'dedicated.cfg' or 'dedicated_sp.cfg' (as applicable). Alternatively enable a playlist for Multiplayer

configurationFields.label: Initial Game Type (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the game type to start the server with in Multiplayer mode. This setting will be overridden if map rotation is configured. Settings for each game type can be set in 'dedicated.cfg'

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with. See 'dedicated.cfg' or 'dedicated_sp.cfg' (as applicable) for map names. This setting will be overridden if map rotation is configured

configurationFields.label: Load Mod
configurationFields.description: Sets the mod to load when starting the server, based on the path to the mod in the 'Plutonium/storage/t5' directory

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time. Maximum 18 for Multiplayer, 4 for Zombies

configurationFields.label: Fast Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for [fast download](https://plutonium.pw/docs/server/t5/fastdl/) of mods

configurationFields.label: RCON Rate Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the RCON rate limit (per IP). Localhost RCON commands are not rate limited

configurationFields.label: Chat Spam Protection
configurationFields.description: Sets the chat spam protection level

configurationFields.label: Kick Ban Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the duration before a kicked player can rejoin the server

configurationFields.label: Private Reserved Slots (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of private reserved slots on the server

configurationFields.label: Private Slot Password (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the password needed to use a private reserved slot

configurationFields.label: Match Data Verification (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, match data verification between client and server will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Reconnect Limit (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of times a player can attempt to reconnect

configurationFields.label: Idle Timeout (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the idle time period before a player is kicked

configurationFields.label: Connection Timeout (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the timeout period for connection attempts or interruptions

configurationFields.label: Allow File IO
configurationFields.description: If set, GSC scripts will be allowed to interact with files on the OS filesystem in a special scriptdata folder

configurationFields.label: Kill Infinite Loops
configurationFields.description: If set, the game will be allowed to kill threads in the GSC engine it thinks are malfunctioning

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, voice chat will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Server Voice Chat Quality
configurationFields.description: Sets the server voice quality level

configurationFields.label: Kick Idle Players
configurationFields.description: If set, idle/AFK players will be auto-kicked from the server after the specified time

configurationFields.label: Player Collision Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets who players collide with

configurationFields.label: Player Ejection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets from whom players are ejected

configurationFields.label: Disable Client Console
configurationFields.description: Enables or disables players' ability to access server commands

configurationFields.label: Enable Team To Affect Bullet Penetration
configurationFields.description: If enabled, team members will affect bullet penetration

configurationFields.label: Fix Bullet Damage Duplication
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the issue where players that are clipped inside each other receive duplicate bullet damage will be fixed

configurationFields.label: Allow Rocket Jumps
configurationFields.description: If enabled, upward knockback from rocket shots will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Fix Viewkick Duplication
configurationFields.description: If set, an issue where viewkick is doubled will be fixed

configurationFields.label: Player Collision Ejection Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the speed at which players are ejected from each other

configurationFields.label: Allow Friendly Grenade Throwback
configurationFields.description: If set, throwing back friendly grenades will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Show Friendly Grenades On HUD
configurationFields.description: If set, friendly grenades will be shown on the HUD

configurationFields.label: Fix Entity Leaks
configurationFields.description: If set, various engine-related issues where entities leak will be fixed

configurationFields.label: Allow Voting (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, voting will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Double CoD Points (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Enables earning double CoD Points for finished matches

configurationFields.label: Minimum Players In Pre-Match Lobby (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of players required in the pre-match lobby

configurationFields.label: XP Scale (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the XP multiplier for round-end scores

configurationFields.label: Wager Bet Amount (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost to connect to a wager gamemode

configurationFields.label: Server Say Name (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the name that server-side 'say' commands show up as

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Duration (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the duration a player can use voice chat

configurationFields.label: Allow Dead Player Voice Chat (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, voice chat for dead players will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Enable Global Voice Chat (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, global voice chat will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Minimum Starting Players (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum players needed to start the game. Do NOT set this higher than the Player Limit!

configurationFields.label: Fix Unkillable Zombies Bug (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If set, fixes the unkillable zombies in traps bug

configurationFields.label: Use Enhanced Weapon Rate (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If set, Doubletap 2.0 will be used instead of the old (vanilla) Doubletap

configurationFields.label: Fix Tesla Bug (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If setm a GSC issue where health is set but not max health will be fixed

deploymentSteps.name: Disable Prefix Sound
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && wget -q -N https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Winetricks/winetricks/master/src/winetricks && chmod +x winetricks; export WINEPREFIX=\"{SERVER_DIR}/.wine\"; export WINEARCH=win32; ./winetricks sound=disabled > winescript_log.txt 2>&1"

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
